answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after locking stake in a public registry, with each account’s weight capped and rewards released gradually over a long horizon. A new identity therefore adds no influence unless the attacker commits more capital; splitting the same stake across a violet swarm of accounts does not multiply its capped weight. To overwhelm honest agents, an attacker must buy and lock substantial stake, tying up funds and risking slashing if proven to equivocate—a costly nebula, not a free reset.
